title: Brahma Ashtakam
intro: Lord Brahma is revered as the creator of the universe in Hindu mythology, occupying the first position in the Trimurti.
description:
Chaturvaktram Chaturbahum Srishtisthityantakaranam |
Akshamaladharam Devam Brahmanam Pranamamyaham ||1||

Kamalasanamasinam Shwetavarnam Chaturmukham |
Vedavacham Vidhataram Brahmanam Pranamamyaham ||2||

Kamandaludharam Haste Sruksruvau Cha Karambuje |
Padmasane Sthitham Nityam Brahmanam Pranamamyaham ||3||

HamsavahanamArudham Mekhalayajnasutrinam |
Hiranyagarbham Varadam Brahmanam Pranamamyaham ||4||

Savitrisahitam Devam Vedamatrisamanvitam |
Prajapatim Jagatsrashta Brahmanam Pranamamyaham ||5||

Rajasam Gunasampannam Srishtikartaramishwaram |
Virinchim Pitaram Vishwasya Brahmanam Pranamamyaham ||6||

Chaturvedaswarupam Cha Chaturyugavidhayakam |
Aadikavi Kavim Vande Brahmanam Pranamamyaham ||7||

Nabhikamalasambhutam Vishwornarayanascha |
Shatanandam Sadanandam Brahmanam Pranamamyaham ||8||

॥ Iti Shri Brahma Ashtakam Sampoornam ॥

faq.a1: It is a sacred eight-verse (Ashtakam) hymn dedicated to Lord Brahma, glorifying his divine attributes, forms, and role as the creator of the universe.
faq.q2: Which forms and attributes of Lord Brahma are described in it?
faq.a2: He is described as Chaturvaktra (four-faced), Chaturbahu (four-armed), seated on a lotus or riding a swan (Hamsa), holding a kamandalu and akshamala, accompanied by Goddess Savitri, and known as the primordial creator (Vidhi/Vidhatra).
faq.q3: What are the benefits of reciting Shri Brahma Ashtakam?
faq.a3: Reciting this hymn helps attain spiritual focus, mental peace, and invokes the divine grace of the creator of the universe.
faq.a4: In Sanskrit poetic tradition, an "Ashtakam" specifically refers to a devotional composition consisting of exactly eight stanzas.
